definition: A physical production asset or piece of equipment on the shop floor.
A human worker who interacts with machines or processes.
A finished or semi-finished item produced by a manufacturing process.
A defined sequence of actions that transforms inputs into outputs.
A physical place such as a factory floor area
A defined time period during which a group of workers operates.
A quality issue where a product does not meet specification.
The process of correcting a defective product so it meets specification.
A period during which a machine or process is not producing output.
The rate at which a system produces or processes units over time.
A point in time recorded as an ISO-8601 date-time string.
The current condition or state of an entity or process.
A unique identifier for a record or entity.
A human-readable name or label for an entity.
The classification or category of an entity.
A device that measures a physical quantity and produces a signal.
Scheduled or reactive activities to keep equipment in operating condition.
A group of products produced together under the same conditions.
The time taken to complete one unit of production from start to finish.
Overall Equipment Effectiveness: a composite measure of manufacturing productivity.
